tips.text: Run Halako Perimeter and nothing else; the angel sits in one of a few big rooms and the run has no time limit.
Take the Zariman bounty stage that says to awaken and defeat a dormant Void Angel; it spawns one with a waypoint.
Kill the dormant angel with three health bars for the Pinion; the two-bar Ravenous angels drop Quills instead.
Bring Blast damage for the angel; it takes extra from it.
Use Unairu's Caustic Strike to strip the angel's armor.
Burst its Ethereal shield with Madurai Void Strike before it summons the gold orbs and you skip that phase.
Stop meleeing after the first health bar; its red mist heals it off any damage it deals you, and self-healing specters make it worse.
Skip Nekros, Hydroid and Chesa for extra Pinions; the double drop no longer works.
Aim at the angel's head; it counts as a weak point.
Bring any basic amp and favor range over damage for the Ethereal phase.
Void Sling through a gold orb and stand near the centre of the dome it makes; it boosts amp damage and blocks the beams.
Shoot the charging red orb above the angel with your amp to stagger it and cancel the attack.
Finish the Exterminate objective before you hunt the angel; failing the mission voids every plume you picked up.
Shoot the ground spikes at your feet with a small-area amp shot; being impaled forces Operator form and can stick.
Abort and restart if the angel passes a health bar without a portal to enter; that run cannot finish.
Run Evolutions III and IV solo; progress often fails to register for clients.
File a support ticket if the Evolution IV rupture counter freezes instead of grinding more Void Flood.
Build Evolution I's combo with Innodem itself; an exalted weapon's combo counter does not count.
Pair Innodem with Laetum and Felarx for the cheapest Incarnon in every slot.
Most players build Innodem only for Evolution V on other weapons, then go back to Praedos.
Expect five short Halako runs for the Pinions; Entrati Lanthorns are what usually holds players up.
